text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic photographic studio character asset, natural skin pores and fine individual hair, realistic cotton and knit detail. Pure white seamless background, bright soft frontal daylight balanced fill, low shadows, realistic 50mm lens perspective, no plastic skin, no illustration or 3D, no text or labels or logos.  A 23-year-old woman with warm fair skin, soft freckles, brunette hair loosely tied in a low ponytail with soft long face-framing bangs, gray-green eyes, oval face with softly defined cheekbones, straight nose, natural muted rose lips. White open-collar blouse, camel wool blazer, small round gold pendant necklace, chocolate brown calf-length softly draping A-line skirt, bare lower legs, brown leather ankle boots. Tall softly curvy healthy 178 cm figure. Exactly three equally spaced full-body views of ONE SAME person in one horizontal row: strict FRONT at left, strict 90-degree SIDE profile facing image-left in center, strict 180-degree BACK at right. Consistent identity, clothing, hairstyle, shoes and 7.8-head tall long-limbed anatomy. Relaxed straight upright stance arms by sides. Every figure fully visible from hair to soles with margin, identical height, same baseline. Pure white ground, narrow white gutters, landscape 3:2. No text. Tall elegant female fashion-model anatomy with approximately 7.8 anatomical head lengths from skull crown to bare-foot soles. Head including skull but excluding hair volume is about 12.8% of total standing body height, visibly smaller relative to the body than a 6–7-head figure. Long naturally proportioned legs and arms, normal-length neck, natural shoulder width and pelvis. Do not elongate her face or neck or merely enlarge shoes. Straight camera with no foreshortening.
